lines.en: One stride carries me across the woods.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌落地，树都在抖
lines.en: My foot lands, and the trees shudder.
I duck under a cloud.
This enormous body moves slowly.
Half a forest splinters under me.
I turn my body toward you.
My tail flattens a row of trees.
Every step I take feels like a quake.
I raise a hand and blot out the sun.
I cross from one side of the hills to the other.

lines.zh: 我的影子把整座村盖住
lines.en: My shadow covers a whole village.

lines.zh: 我慢慢弯下腰，看清脚下
lines.en: I bend slowly to see what is underfoot.
I stand taller than the hills.
Wind passes through my horns.
I hold still like a huge boulder.
My breath parts the clouds.
I am listening to something far away.
I rest a hand on the mountain.
My eyes are glowing.

lines.zh: 我低头看着脚下的小东西
lines.en: I look down at the tiny things below.
I crush the stone in my palm.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤像着火的岩壳
lines.en: My hide is a burning shell of rock.
I let out a slow breath.
I shake the ash off my hide.
I blot out half the sky.
Down there you are the size of a grain of sand.
I look down, and only then do you appear.
The ground you stand on is shaking.
I know that kind of presence.
You are a little bigger than I expected.
I am deciding whether to bend down.

lines.zh: 你的声音传不到我这儿
lines.en: Your voice does not reach up here.
I lean over, and the sky darkens.
Look up at me and your neck will ache.
One hand of mine would cover you.
Your ki is small, but bright.

lines.zh: 我很久没见过敢抬头的人
lines.en: Few dare look up at me.
If you have words, make them loud.
I stop right above you.

lines.zh: 你身后那片林子我踩过
lines.en: I have already crushed the woods behind you.
I lower my head and the wind presses down.
Run if you like; one step of mine is enough.
I look at you without a word.
This sting is like a mosquito bite.
I look down at the wound.

lines.zh: 是谁在我身上挠了一下
lines.en: Who scratched me?

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，声浪传得很远
lines.en: I roar, and it carries far.
I sway.
A pale line appears on my hide.
I shake my hand out.

lines.zh: 这一下让我注意到了你
lines.en: That made me notice you.
My breathing deepens.
I am not falling yet.
That would not fill one bite of mine.
You hold that up for me?

lines.zh: 我看不清那么小的东西
lines.en: I cannot make out anything that small.
I do not need to be fed.
You want me to bend down.
I bend, and the ground gives way.
Even in my hand it is a speck.
I do not feel hungry at all.
Keep that little thing.
I glanced at it once.
You struck my foot.
I did not even feel it.
I lift my foot and you must move.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾比你的房子大
lines.en: My toe is bigger than your house.
That moved me half an inch.
Do not stand where I put my foot.
A mountain nearly tripped me.

lines.zh: 我把你旁边的树踩平了
lines.en: I flattened the trees beside you.
My knee scrapes the ridge.
Pushing me is like pushing a wall.

lines.zh: 我这样的体型，找不到伴
lines.en: Creatures my size find no company.
I have walked alone a long time.

lines.zh: 这片天地容不下两个我
lines.en: This land cannot hold two of me.
I have no such thought.
I only want to eat and destroy.
You are asking the wrong one.
Even the mountains are gentler than me.
I snort, and the clouds scatter.
Do not bother me with this.
I turn and walk away.

lines.zh: 我弯下腰，抓起一整片地
lines.en: I bend and scoop up a whole patch of ground.

lines.zh: 这点东西在我手里看不见
lines.en: It vanishes in my hand.
I pinch it up and look.
One squeeze and it crumbles.
What would I want this for?
I hold it like a grain of sand.
It is far too light in my palm.

lines.zh: 我把地皮一起抓起来了
lines.en: I took the turf along with it.
Whoever dropped it, I am not returning it.
I have finally seen you.
Your ki is bright and cannot hide.
I look down and fix your position.
You stand out too clearly.
This time I will not take my time.
I raise my hand above the clouds.
You cannot outrun my shadow.
I have settled on you.
I can see you from beyond the hills.
One step brings me to you.
Your ki is bleeding away.
I roar, and the clouds tear.
I open my hand and the sky goes dark.
Now your turn comes.
I do not like being looked up at for long.
I have already set out.
I lean down and press on the whole sky.
You are inside the shadow of my palm.
I raise my hand, slowly.
I have already measured your retreat.
You go left, I go left.
My steps split the ground.
I am not rushing; you cannot escape.
I watch that bright speck.
My hand is raised as high as it goes.
Do you hear the wind changing?
My breath becomes a wave of heat.
My body has swallowed your shadow.
I shift one step forward.
The hills crack beneath me.
I roar again, closer this time.
What exactly are you waiting for?
I do not intend to give you a chance.
In the last instant, I move.
My hand comes down.
A whole forest is flattened.
Was that enough?
My fist grazes the ridge.
Debris falls like rain.
The shockwave throws you.
I lift my foot and bring it down.
The ground caves into a crater.
When I roar, you cannot stand.
One palm of mine covers a village.
I swat out without looking.
My nail rakes the cliff.
Blood on my hand is a single red dot.
I add one final blow.
I have erased this place.
The clouds tear and I come down.
I rise from behind the mountain.
The ground sinks before I appear.
My shadow arrives before I do.
The sky over this region changes colour.
I open my eyes, and thunder answers.
My breath bends the trees.
I have walked here from very far.
The hills grow short beneath me.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声闷响是我
lines.en: That deep sound you heard was me.
I brace a hand on the summit.
The air here is too thin.

lines.zh: 我低头，第一次看清这片地
lines.en: I look down and see this land for the first time.
The rock shell on my body still burns.
The birds fled first.
When I landed, the river changed course.
My horn tears through the clouds.
I stand here, and the sky comes lower.

lines.zh: 火烧在我身上，像被挠了一下
lines.en: Fire on my hide feels like a scratch.

lines.zh: 我从云里摔下来，砸出一个坑
lines.en: I fall from the clouds and make a crater.
The water only reaches my knee.
The blast blooms at my feet.
Magic coils around my horn.
I have been hungry a long time.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我抖了一下
lines.en: Lightning hits me and I twitch.
The ground below me simply vanishes.
